tagline: A four-room house by the sea at Kihim, Alibaug.
description: Saltwater is a four-room whitewashed house by the sea at Kihim, Alibaug: slow days, a long table, and the Konkan coast two hours from Mumbai.

sections.title: Everything is *included*
sections.text: One price for the room, three meals and the little things. No bill at the end.

items.title: Meals from our *kitchen*
items.text: Breakfast, lunch and dinner, cooked by Sunita and her team with fish from Revdanda and vegetables from the village.

items.title: Ferry *pick-up*
items.text: We meet you at Mandwa jetty and drive you the twenty minutes to the house.

items.title: Bicycles and *towels*
items.text: Six bicycles, beach towels, umbrellas and a picnic basket, whenever you want them.

sections.title: Plan your *stay*
sections.text: Choose the day you'll arrive and we'll confirm your room and dates on WhatsApp within the hour. Two-night minimum at weekends.

items.q: How do we get there from Mumbai?
items.a: Take the ferry from the Gateway of India to Mandwa (about an hour). We'll pick you up from the jetty. By road it's about three hours.
Children of all ages, yes. Pets by arrangement: tell us when you book.

items.q: Can we book the whole house?
items.a: Yes, for up to ten guests. Ask us on WhatsApp for dates and the whole-house rate.
